_comment: Hand-proposed labelled (evidence, original, bullet) pairs for fitting the support check's thresholds (issue #237). Built only from the synthetic benchmark profiles in eval/profiles/ (never personal/); every evidence string is a verbatim source bullet. `label` is a PROPOSED label awaiting user review: supported | adds_unsupported | contradicts. `original` is the bullet being revised (shown to Jev as context, never evidence) and is null on some pairs. `negation` marks evidence that hinges on a negation (did not / without / rather than / no-op). `touches_numbers` marks pairs whose change touches a figure, which #123's regex gate also sees. Regenerate the report with `python eval/fit_support_threshold.py analyze`.
